CommunityApplications.Profile: UGREEN DXP4800 Pro LEDs for the UGREEN DXP4800 Pro running Unraid. This repository contains the plugin, matching kernel module, sources, licenses and Community Applications metadata. Support: https://forums.unraid.net/topic/201027-plugin-ugreen-dxp4800-pro-leds/. Bug reports: https://github.com/EllipticSet/UGREEN-DXP4800Pro-LEDs/issues. Requires Unraid 7.3.2 or later and a matching bundled module for kernel 6.18.38-Unraid, 6.18.54-Unraid or 6.18.58-Unraid.
